## Summary

Sidhanth S is a Software Engineer and Full-Stack Developer based in Chennai, India.

His work focuses on software systems, workflow automation, developer platforms, AI-assisted applications, and modern web engineering. He builds products that combine technical architecture, operational workflows, and user experience into production-ready systems.
